server.bind.description: IP address owserver binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, or 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

server.port.description: TCP port on which owserver listens for API connections.

server.allow.description: List of IP addresses permitted to connect to the owserver API.

buses.description: List of 1-Wire bus configurations. Each bus defines how owserver connects to a physical 1-Wire network.

features.cache.description: Enable caching of 1-Wire device values to reduce bus traffic. Recommended for most deployments.

features.allow_set.description: Allow clients to set (write) configuration parameters on devices (e.g., alarm thresholds).

features.allow_write.description: Allow clients to write to device memory (e.g., EEPROM). Use with caution.

timeouts.connection.description: Maximum seconds to wait when establishing a connection to a 1-Wire device or bus adapter.

timeouts.read.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a read operation on a 1-Wire device.

timeouts.write.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a write operation on a 1-Wire device.

logging.level.description: Logging verbosity. 'debug' is very verbose; 'warning' or 'error' recommended for production.

logging.file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logs are written to standard output.

fuse.mount_point.description: Directory where OWFS filesystem will be mounted (requires FUSE). Example: /mnt/1wire. Leave empty to disable FUSE.

fuse.allow_other.description: Allow other users (besides the owserver user) to access the mounted OWFS filesystem.
